_doc: Where each manpu icon sits on a character's head. anchor: head_top | forehead | temple_face | temple_back (face = the side the character looks at; mirrored when it turns). offset: icon center from the anchor in px, x toward the face. scale: keep 1 (pixel art), 0.5 at most. shade: dark gradient over the upper face (gloom). flip: mirror the icon itself when the character looks left. See docs/DATA_SCHEMA.md.

hero._anim_head_offset: Head moves with these animations (crouch, jump).
